researchQuestion: After the exact two-hook private mediator grammar closes, has any immutable experiment measured both a remaining policy-repertoire bottleneck and prospective decision value sufficient to authorise ML, RL or another optimiser; if not, what is the next smallest non-adaptive deterministic mechanism class?
competingOptions: authorise a separately preregistered policy-method design only when an explicit policy-repertoire bottleneck and measured intervention decision value are both present
keep ML, RL and optimisers prohibited and freeze one deterministic exclusive-acquisition mechanism class for source feasibility only
record the method boundary inconclusive at the frozen cap
claimBoundary: This zero-row audit may reject method authority and name one mechanism class for an exact-source feasibility audit. It cannot select a card, relic, effect, acquisition point, policy, value, candidate, simulator design or shipping change, and cannot repair or reopen a closed or quarantined family.

classificationRules.policyRepertoireBottleneck: An immutable result must explicitly locate the first failed necessary condition in policy choice or repertoire rather than substrate opportunity, acquisition exposure, legality, observation, carrier overlap or unresolved play selection.
classificationRules.measuredDecisionValue: An immutable matched intervention or declared retrospective decision-value audit must show that changing the policy method could cross the relevant activation and two-sided separation gates without unresolved identity, sensitivity or interference failure.
classificationRules.methodAuthority: Both conditions must be true for the same still-admissible package family. A predictive model with non-positive held-out signal, a candidate-specific bottleneck on a quarantined family or a theoretical oracle is insufficient.
classificationRules.structuralProgression: When no method is authorised and the complete two-hook combat-local grammar is exhausted, progress exactly one complexity rung to source feasibility for a deterministic acquisition dimension. Do not construct or tune a gameplay candidate.

nextStructuralClass.whyThisClass: The latest valid capacity result passed carrier support, inactivity, opportunity, viability, reliability and Scoreline separation but failed only because card-reward acceptance overlapped Afterimage. The next causal dimension must therefore be acquisition identity rather than another payoff or carrier scalar.
nextStructuralClass.minimumDefinition: One Dusk-specific, player-selectable, mutually exclusive and reproducible package-acquisition contract using an existing deterministic product path if exact source permits it. It must make package exposure independently observable without overriding cardDecline, changing Scoreline or Afterimage payoff, or adding RNG.
nextStructuralClass.sourceAuditOnly: The next stage may inventory exact acquisition, internal-ID, save and policy-choice surfaces and decide feasible, unavailable or contract-breaking. It may not choose a relic or card ID, implement, open support, run Godot or simulate.

decisionRules.success: No immutable result satisfies any of the seven policy-method authority signals; the post-quarantine census selected exactly the private status design, generated debt is quarantined, the exact status design is closed, and all evidence and ledger identities pass within 30 seconds.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1. Keep ML, RL and every optimiser prohibited. Freeze only deterministic-exclusive-package-acquisition for one separately preregistered exact-source feasibility audit of current acquisition, save/internal-ID and policy-choice surfaces. Do not name or implement a candidate, inspect support, run Godot or simulate.
decisionRules.futility: A still-admissible family has both an explicit policy-repertoire bottleneck and measured method decision value, or the two-hook grammar is not exhausted.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2 and authorise no new method or structural class from this audit. Preregister a dedicated method or unresolved-grammar audit under the exact supporting evidence; do not implement, simulate or optimise here.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Any immutable decision, task capsule, ledger identity or deterministic classification cannot complete at the one-attempt 30-second cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and record the relevant method gate inconclusive without ML, RL, optimiser, structural candidate, support read, implementation, simulator row or protected seed. Invoke only the current human-authority contract if no safe evidence-backed continuation remains.

methodBoundary: Issue 524 and 525 are immutable scientific evidence only and are not reopened or reconstructed. Deterministic Python owns evidence validation, classification and stop/go. The exact false signals are published; no model, human label or interpretation after execution changes the decision.
